text: 南向资金今日大幅净卖出100.21亿元。港股通（沪）方面，中芯国际、腾讯控股分别获净卖出7.95亿港元、6.21亿港元；建滔积层板净买入额居首，金额为5.02亿港元；港股通（深）方面，腾讯控股、小米集团-W分别获净卖出14.81亿港元、7.46亿港元；MINIMAX-W净买入额居首，金额为6.66亿港元。
text_en: Southbound capital saw a large net sell-off of 10.021 billion yuan today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect, SMIC and Tencent Holdings saw net sells of 795 million HKD and 621 million HKD respectively; Kingboard Laminates topped net buys with 502 million HKD. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tencent Holdings and Xiaomi Corporation-W saw net sells of 1.481 billion HKD and 746 million HKD respectively; MiniMax-W topped net buys with 666 million HKD.
